name: email-01
description: A sign-in code email with the code on a dark panel, how long it works and who asked for it.

files.content: import { type EmailBrand, EmailFooter, EmailLayout, EmailPanel, EmailPanelNote, EmailPanelValue, EmailSection, EmailText, EmailTitle, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/email' import { formatDate, joinDetails } from '@/registry/lib/dashboardblocks/format' interface SignInRequest { at: Date /** `Chrome on macOS` */ device: string email: string /** `London, United Kingdom` */ location: string } interface Email1Props { brand: EmailBrand code: string expiresInMinutes: number /** A postal address for the footer. */ address?: string /** Who asked for the code, so someone who didn't can tell. */ request?: SignInRequest /** The time zone `request.at` is written in. @default 'UTC' */ timeZone?: string } const exampleProps: Email1Props = { address: '548 Market St, San Francisco', brand: { logo: 'https://www.dashboardblocks.com/images/logo-01.png', name: 'Acme Analytics', }, code: '482913', expiresInMinutes: 10, request: { at: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 29, 9, 42)), device: 'Chrome on macOS', email: 'ana@northwind.com', location: 'London, United Kingdom', }, timeZone: 'Europe/London', } const email1Subject = ({ brand, code }: Email1Props) => `${code} is your ${brand.name} sign-in code` const Email1 = ({ address, brand, code, expiresInMinutes, request, timeZone = 'UTC', }: Email1Props) => ( {joinDetails(brand.name, address)}} > Your sign-in code {code} It works for {expiresInMinutes} minutes. {request ? `Someone asked to sign in as ${request.email} from ${request.device} in ${request.location} at ${formatDate(request.at, 'time-zone', timeZone)}. ` : null} You can ignore this email: nobody can sign in without the code. ) Email1.PreviewProps = exampleProps export default Email1 export { Email1, email1Subject, exampleProps as email1ExampleProps, type Email1Props, type SignInRequest, }
